notes.title: Bug fix update
notes.notes: A bug which affected switching from controller to mouse has been fixed.

notes.title: Controller Remapping
notes.notes: Controller Remapping has been added. Customize the controls to what works best for you! Mouse & keyboard controls can also be remapped.

notes.title: Laptop support & bug fix
notes.notes:
Laptop support has been confirmed. Playable on laptops that meet the specs and either have a high quality touchpad or played with a controller.
A bug which affected the joystick has been fixed.

notes.title: Left Trigger accidental restarts
notes.notes:
Thank you for your valuable feedback!
The left trigger restart is now less sensitive to help reduce accidental restarting.
The gray containers have been removed because they didn't fit the scene.
Flowers were planted.

notes.title: Mouse functionality bug fixed
notes.notes: A bug which disabled mouse functionality has been fixed.
